content:
Welcome to week 16 everyone who made it! We now have only around a month left in the cohort, I hope you are all staying strong and following your planned roadmap. 

Come to share your progress today at our standup 3pm utc as always. I will also share some updates about upcoming weeks so you know how to prepare for the cohort wrap up. But we still have time, focus on your work and share updates as always please!
